rules_implemented: G1 monthly-start rolling window best-gain per stock; pool 99.5% quantile threshold
G2 T3 frozen events; <breakout close & no new high vs prior 20d; severity=max dd; per-stock severity max tie earliest
G3 ret252 cross-sec pct>=90; anchor=fwd peak; dd>=60%; per-stock dd max
G4 vol60 ann. pct<=20 & turn60 pct<=30 run>=504d; launch=first ret20 pct>=85 within 252d; episode needs launch+252
G5 industry equal-weight (hfq-derived, snapshot caveat); r120 >= own-history 95pct (sampling rule, not realtime); segments merged; member 40-60 pct in segment; ind strength tie earliest
